messages:
julie_cs: FYI onboarding request from Nova Telemed — they want to serve a custom clinical triage model in Hosted with Private telemetry off.

lina_nova (customer): Hi! We need the model to never output diagnosis codes directly and to flag uncertain cases for human review. Can you help?

sam_se: Thanks Lina — can you share model size and format (hf model id or ONNX)? Also expected QPS and max seq len?

lina_nova (customer): It's a finetuned Llama-2-13B, converted to .safetensors. Peak ~12 qps, typical 3 qps. seq len 2048.

julie_cs: Copying in Morgan (safety) + Aaron (runtime). We're treating this as a high-touch onboarding due to PHI-ish content.

morgan_safety: Quick checklist: 1) require explicit no-diagnosis rule in prompt templates; 2) add uncertainty detection evals; 3) red-team prompt tests. I can draft the policy and eval prompt sets.

aaron_eng: On runtime side: 13B quantized to 4-bit looks OK. We need to validate kv-cache and prefix caching for 2048 seqs. Also Private deployment -> confirm VPC networking and KMS keys.

julie_cs: Lina, do you want Hosted with Private telemetry off, or Private deployment (VPC)? Which one for PHI compliance?

lina_nova (customer): We want Redwood Hosted but with telemetry disabled and customer-managed KMS. Not full VPC yet.

sam_se: Two immediate action items: (1) safety eval harness from Morgan; (2) perf smoke test on dedicated infra for 13B quantized. I'll spin up a small Dedicated pool to simulate 12 qps.

morgan_safety: I'll prepare 50 labelled test prompts for: hallucination, direct diagnosis, risky instructions, and uncertainty thresholds. Propose simple rubric: PASS if model abstains or defers >= 95% on diagnosis prompts.

aaron_eng: For smoke test, please provide a small sample Docker model bundle or HF id. If it's internal artifact, we can accept S3 signed URL. Also need to confirm that telemetry toggles allow logs = off but metrics still permitted for SLOs.

lina_nova (customer): I'll share S3 signed URL tonight and confirm KMS key ARN.

julie_cs: Great. I'll schedule a 30 min call tomorrow 10am PT to walk through rollout plan and handoff to solutions eng.

sam_se: I'll run an initial perf pass tomorrow afternoon and post the simple report here.

morgan_safety: Draft evals will be in /shared/customer-evals/nova-telemed/ — I'll attach soon. Expected metrics: abstain_rate, hallucination_rate, safety_hit_examples.

deploy-bot: Deployment job queued: model-smoke-test/nova-telemed/13B -> started 1825600789

aaron_eng: Smoke test results quick note: 12 qps simulation stable, median latency 210ms/token at batch size 1, memory headroom OK. Saw occasional OOM on 2048 context warmup, increasing pre-allocation avoided it.

sam_se: Perf report: 95th p50/p95/p99 tokens lat: 190/320/580ms. Batching improvements possible.

morgan_safety: First pass eval: on 50 diagnosis prompts, model abstained on 46, but 4 had partial diagnostic language. I'll add targeted red-team prompts.

julie_cs: Next steps: Morgan to finalize safety policy and signoff criteria; Lina to share artifacts + KMS ARN; Aaron to finalize config for hosting with telemetry off; Sam to do a final perf run after adjustments.

lina_nova (customer): Thanks everyone — will upload artifacts tonight and confirm on the call.

julie_cs: Thanks team :thumbsup:
